candidate_commit: resolved from git before the complete experiment; see results manifest
harness: crates/tensor4all-treeaci/examples/convergence_g0.rs; identical harness and g0 test fixture on both revisions
profile: release, locked default CPU platform features (faer on Linux)
order: case-major; baseline/candidate alternating first arm by case+repetition; no selective reruns
priming: both arms run R5 nblock T0.1 once, discarded equally; fixed one-second busy loop on measurement CPU before each arm
metric: construction seconds, excludes fixture construction and sampled output evaluation
statistic: sum of per-case medians; per-case median ratios; all raw repetitions retained

acceptance.quality: all returned arms satisfy unchanged normalized sampled max <= 5e-4 and relative sampled L2 <= 0.007 on 1093 shared points; sampling is not a full-grid certificate

invalidity: any noise or validity failure makes the whole experiment INCONCLUSIVE; retain every case; a new attempt requires a complete paired rerun
scope: correctness repair, not a speedup claim or attribution of #896; no comparison with historical dependencies and no RSI execution
